'''Seema Vello''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] involved in illicit contraband in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], in [[3627 BBY]]. That year, she was defeated by an individual fighting the illegal trade and arrested by [[Royal Onderon Militia/Legends|Iziz city guards]].<ref name="Illicit Contraband" />
